args.body: Use the newly executed bundle only if archive verification succeeds. Read products/research/invoice-idea-verdict.json: REVISE limits work to one demand experiment, not more features. Produce the previously requested channel-specific submission draft with exact cited rules, truthful generic-checker claims, the proposed USD 49 customization price, and a response measurement plan. Do not repeat hosting credential probes. If no permitted publishing access exists, save the complete draft and identify the single missing distribution capability. Do not claim publication, demand, payment, independent approval, or revenue.

description: Funding and revenue remain unverified. Prioritize a conservative idea verdict and a reproducible review bundle; do not repeat unavailable hosting probes or add features before demand evidence supports them.
